parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'readOnly', true,
  'checkedAt', clock_timestamp(),
  'n8nExecutions24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.execution_entity WHERE "startedAt" >= now() - interval '24 hours'),
  'n8nUnfinishedExecutions', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" IS NULL),
  'executionDataBytes', pg_total_relation_size('public.execution_data'),
  'executionEntityBytes', pg_total_relation_size('public.execution_entity'),
  'whatsappHealth', whatsapp_ai.get_health_status(),
  'deadDeliveries', (SELECT count(*) FROM whatsapp_ai.deliveries WHERE status = 'dead'),
  'pendingDeliveries', (SELECT count(*) FROM whatsapp_ai.deliveries WHERE status = 'pending'),
  'sendingDeliveries', (SELECT count(*) FROM whatsapp_ai.deliveries WHERE status = 'sending'),
  'pendingBatches', (SELECT count(*) FROM whatsapp_ai.batches WHERE status = 'pending'),
  'processingBatches', (SELECT count(*) FROM whatsapp_ai.batches WHERE status = 'processing'),
  'opsDryRun', COALESCE((SELECT value = 'true' FROM whatsapp_ai.settings WHERE key = 'ops_dry_run'), true)
) AS diagnostics
